Gatekeeper Esmeralda:
The outskirts of Hunters' Village are swarming with monsters. But if you use my teleport service, you won't have to deal with them!
Would you like to return to your home village? Maybe a friend is waiting for you somewhere? Or what about a vacation at the seaside? Wherever you want to go, we, Gatekeepers, will always be happy to help you.
(You can teleport for free if your main class is Lv. 104 or lower.)
